title: Kenyan Fish Bread
description: A hearty and flavorful bread topped with a spicy fish mixture, perfect for a Kenyan-inspired meal.

ingredients.name: Energizing
ingredients.notes: or any hot pepper of your choice

ingredients.name: Kenyang
ingredients.notes: or any other Kenyan spice blend

instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a pan, heat the energizing and kenyang over medium heat.
Add the fish pieces to the pan and cook until they're opaque and flake easily with a fork.
Stir in the salt to taste.
Add the bread cubes to the pan and toss to coat with the fish mixture.
Transfer the bread and fish mixture to a baking dish.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the fish is heated through.
Note: You can also grill the bread and fish mixture for a crispy exterior and a tender interior.
